author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Since Teamspeak Appeals were quite confusing and mixed in with regular in-game appeals, We will now be handling teamspeak appeals in this new subforum

HOW TO APPEAL TEAMSPEAK PUNISHMENT:

Open a new discussion and fill out this format and add it to your discussion

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Client UUID (that you were banned on):
Type of Punishment (if ban, name how long the ban is):
Reasoning to why your ban should be appealed:
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The staff member who punished you will be the first ones to respond to your appeal. If you do not agree with the staff member's decision, the punishment will be directed towards Teamspeak Developers who will handle your punishment.

Good Luck!

Thanks,
The Teamspeak Developers

Note:
To get your client uid, go to "Settings" then "Identities" and paste the UID of the identity you were banned on.
